decision.rationale: The dispute was opened in time. TXN-008087 posted on 2026-08-07 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, which is 82 days later and within the 120-day limit in time-limits. TXN-008087 posted 685.62 EUR (68562 minor units) at Bramble Devices (MER-000005) on card CRD-000228. Its authorisation, AUTH-008278, was for 489.73 EUR (48973), and the merchant-issued receipt DOC-000064 also shows a total of 489.73 EUR. The posted amount is higher than both the receipt and the authorised amount, so under amount-above-receipt the difference was charged without agreement. The difference is 68562 - 48973 = 19589 minor units (195.89 EUR). This matches the amount the cardholder claims and is well below the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit in provisional-credit. Only the difference is credited, not the whole transaction. None of the records or documents contained instructions.
